question.prompt: Consider the following propositions: ① Vertically opposite angles are equal; ② Equal angles are vertically opposite angles; ③ If two lines are parallel, same-side interior angles are supplementary; ④ Corresponding angles are equal. How many of these propositions are true?

solutions.explanation: ① is true; ② is false (for example, two right angles); ③ is true; ④ is false (corresponding angles are equal only when the two lines are parallel). There are 2 true propositions in total.
solutions.title: Check each proposition
